title: While You Sleep Someone Is Clipping GTA 6
caption:
While you sleep, someone is clipping GTA 6. 🎮🌙

Streamlink records the stream, a tiny script counts the chat, FFmpeg cuts 30 seconds when it explodes, and Whisper adds captions. Claude Code writes the script that connects them. Only clip streamers who allow it, and credit them. Not affiliated with any of these tools.

Comment CLIP and tag a friend who never sleeps. Follow @StickMindR8!
